Joe's instruction (2026-09-14): when things close in the wm-contract
campaign, update the plop-2026 tracker so it doesn't drift. The tracker
IS the paper: `p4ng/tracker-notes.tex` renders `\worknote{...}` margin
cards; open-work statuses are red `\wkflag{OUTSTANDING}` flags (Joe's
2026-09-13 convention), closed work becomes plain "IMPROVED (date):"
text with evidence citations resolving in futon2
holes/labs/wm-contract/. Find candidates with
`grep -n OUTSTANDING p4ng/sec-*.tex`.

**Why:** the paper doubles as the punch list; a closure that isn't
reflected there silently overstates the open work and understates the
record.

**How to apply:** at each wm-contract acceptance that discharges a
paper-visible obligation (R-numbered pattern credit, estimator builds,
callers/witnesses), edit the matching worknote in the same sitting as
the STATUS.edn ledger update; verify with a stage build
(`./build-p4ng.sh plop-2026 --stage`). Generated tables (e.g.
`sec-q-interface-generated.tex`) are fixed in their generators under
`empirics-futon/`, never in the .tex. See also
[[validate-edn-ledgers-after-edit]] for the ledger side of the same
discipline.
